title: Canon of the Unmaking Spear
summary: A canon for those past the primers that turns the soul spear into a weapon able to break guards of will and scatter a crowd of minds.

title: A Treatise on the Breaking Wave of Will
summary: A treatise on sending soul force out in rolling waves that press upon a foe and then crash across a whole line.

title: The Seam and Unstitching Canon
summary: A canon on finding the stitching of a soul and pulling it out thread by thread until the foe's will comes apart.

title: The Twin Needle Discipline
summary: The Azure Sky discipline of striking with a matched pair of soul needles so that one opens the guard and the other lands.

title: Manual of the Paired Hawk Strike
summary: The Azure Sky manual of the hawk's stoop done in pairs where two strokes of soul force fall together on one mark.

title: The Basin and River of Will
summary: The Azure Sky teaching of filling the will like a basin and letting it run out in a river of force that sweeps a foe along.

title: The Oath-Sworn Edge
summary: The Gale teaching of swearing the soul's edge to a vow so that every cut carries the weight of the word given.

title: Bearing and the Held Line
summary: The Gale discipline of taking a bearing on a foe's will and holding that line of force steady through a long exchange.

title: The Unwalled Mind Reckoning
summary: The Gale reckoning of the mind with no walls set about it so that soul force moves like wind and strips whatever it meets.
